name: Shreya Jain
notable_products: Face Shop x Shreya Jain Kit
detailed_bio: Shreya Jain stands out as one of India’s pioneering beauty influencers, shaping contemporary beauty content across YouTube and Instagram since 2010. Born and raised in Delhi, Shreya holds a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication and an Executive MBA in Social Media and Business Analytics. Her early career was a swift transition from engineering to fashion and beauty, fueled by a keen interest that started in her college years. She launched her YouTube channel “SJlovesJewelry” with DIY and makeup tutorials, quickly gaining recognition for her engaging, accessible teaching style. As her following grew, she expanded into in-depth makeup reviews, skincare rituals, and easy-to-follow trend content, always emphasizing inclusivity, affordability, and practical skill-building for her audience. Shreya's blog “Beauty In The Third World” and her collaborations with POPxo in 2017 solidified her status as an authority in Indian beauty blogging, inspiring a new generation of creators to begin their own digital journeys.

Through her relentless content creation and dedication to authenticity, Shreya became the first Indian beauty blogger to launch her own product lines with brands like YBP, TheFaceShop, and MAC. Her makeup sponges with YBP are favorites among professional makeup artists and fellow bloggers. Her career as a stylist included major fashion events like the Amazon India Fashion Week, Lakme Fashion Week, and editorial collaborations with titles such as The Man Magazine, where she combined technical finesse with bold creativity. Jain’s personal style, often described as “easy with a touch of glam,” and her openness about her inspirations (ranging from Nick Knight’s artistry to Bollywood icons like Anaita Shroff Adajania) have helped her remain relevant even as digital beauty trends evolve.

Beyond beauty tutorials, Shreya is famous for her “Top 10” product videos, affordable product dupes playlists, and “raw” reviews, which have earned her a trusted reputation in an industry that often struggles with transparency. Known for her independence, she rarely delves into her personal life or uses relatability narratives, focusing instead on honest product assessments. Her influence extends beyond the screen: she’s styled celebrities such as Rana Daggubati, collaborated on looks for Punjabi music videos, and participated at elite luncheons with Bollywood stars and global brands. Frequented by millions for her trendsetting Navratri reels and festival content, she has become an enduring figure, with over 750,000 YouTube subscribers and 457,000 Instagram followers as of 2025—setting benchmarks for both aspirants and established creators in the Indian beauty space.
fun_fact: Styled celebrities like Rana Daggubati at major fashion weeks.

name: Ankita Chaturvedi
detailed_bio: Ankita Chaturvedi is a renowned Indian beauty influencer, widely recognized for her inclusive approach to skincare and makeup tutorials. Born in 1990 in Mumbai, Ankita graduated as an engineer from IIT Bombay before pivoting her career to the beauty industry. Her journey into content creation began with her passion for skincare, leading her to establish the popular blog Corallista, which became a go-to platform for reviews and tips for diverse skin types. Her approachable style, honest product reviews, and focus on makeup for Indian skin tone helped her rapidly grow a dedicated following that now numbers over 635,000 subscribers on YouTube. Ankita’s content emphasizes empowerment, self-love, and accessible beauty routines that resonate with young audiences seeking genuine, relatable advice.

Apart from her online persona, Ankita has collaborated with major brands like Lakme, Nykaa, and L'Oreal, launching her own product lines and participating in global beauty conferences. Her tutorials often showcase how to enhance natural beauty with minimal effort, making her a role model for students, working professionals, and beauty enthusiasts across India and abroad. Ankita’s reputation is built on her honesty, expertise, and her ability to simplify complex beauty concepts into easy-to-follow guides. Her influence extends beyond social media: she is regularly invited as a panelist at beauty expos and conducts masterclasses in cities like Mumbai and Delhi, inspiring young creators to pursue sustainable and inclusive beauty practices.

Over the years, Ankita has been outspoken about her journey of self-acceptance, promoting body positivity and mental health awareness alongside her beauty content. Her YouTube channel and Instagram are filled with a diverse array of content from detailed product reviews, skincare routines, and makeup tutorials, to personal vlogs and motivational talks. Her transparent approach fosters trust among her followers, many of whom credit her for helping them build confidence and overcome beauty insecurities. As she continues evolving her brand, Ankita remains committed to redefining beauty standards, advocating for authentic representation, and creating inclusive spaces for diverse skin tones and beauty ideals. With her influence expanding globally, she is regarded as one of India’s most influential beauty entrepreneurs and content creators today.
fun_fact: Has led popular bridal workshops + brown-skin beauty masterclasses.

name: Debasree Banerjee
detailed_bio: Debasree Banerjee is an influential Indian beauty and lifestyle blogger known for her candid and warm approach to makeup and skincare. Originally from Assam, she holds a B.Sc. in Biotechnology followed by a Post Graduate Diploma in Marketing. She began her YouTube channel in 2013 and grew her audience by sharing genuine product reviews, skincare routines, and makeup tutorials, often focusing on simplicity and self-care. Beyond beauty, she advocates fitness and wellness, reflecting a holistic approach to lifestyle content that resonates deeply with her followers.

She has been recognized as Cosmopolitan India's Best Beauty Blogger, empowering women to embrace self-confidence and effortless beauty. Debasree’s brand, D/Fine by Debasreee, is dedicated to eyeliners and eyeshadows crafted to inspire creativity and boldness, featuring unique and playful shades. Her content is also known for blending beauty tips with motivational discussions about self-care, wellness, and personal growth, setting her apart from mainstream beauty influencers.

In addition to her digital presence, Debasree is active in social causes, partnering with UNICEF to promote menstrual hygiene awareness in rural India. She balances content creation with family life, sharing occasional glimpses into her personal world while maintaining a professional image. With a loyal subscriber base eagerly awaiting her fresh content, Debasree continues evolving as a role model not only for beauty enthusiasts but for anyone seeking inspiration rooted in authenticity and kindness.
fun_fact: Active philanthropist with UNICEF for girl hygiene in villages.

name: Shalini Samuel (Knot Me)
detailed_bio: Shalini Samuel, founder of the brand 'Knot Me Pretty', is a prominent Mumbai-based haircare and skincare influencer recognized for her expert hairstyling tutorials and product reviews. Trained by Vidal Sassoon, she transitioned from freelancing as a hairstylist to creating engaging digital content that simplifies complex haircare and styling techniques for a broad audience. Shalini's YouTube channel features viral haircare hacks, DIY remedies, and feminine accessories, accumulating a substantial following due to her approachable and educational style.

Her entrepreneurial venture, Knot Me Pretty accessories, complements her content by offering stylish hairpins, clips, and combs designed to enhance everyday looks. Shalini has been credited with popularizing rapid hair tutorials that emphasize easy, effective styling while maintaining hair health. Her commitment to authenticity and quality has established her as one of India's most trusted haircare advisors, earning millions of views and loyal subscribers.

Beyond tutorials, Shalini frequently discusses the challenges of haircare through skincare intersections, encouraging her audience towards holistic beauty routines. She has collaborated with global brands and fashion weeks, expanding her influence beyond YouTube to become a notable figure in India's digital beauty landscape. Shalini's blend of education, entertainment, and product entrepreneurship continues to inspire and empower viewers seeking sustainable beauty solutions.
fun_fact: Her hair tutorials have crossed 146 million views.

name: Malvika Sitlani
detailed_bio: Malvika Sitlani is a celebrated beauty influencer and former model from Mumbai, known for her lifestyle vlogs, makeup tutorials, and candid personal stories. She gained fame through her honesty, charm, and ability to connect with audiences seeking genuine beauty advice. Born in 1990, Malvika has worked with top brands, including L'Oréal, Maybelline, and Smashbox, contributing to international collaborations and campaigns.

She co-founded MASIC Beauty, a vegan and cruelty-free skincare brand, emphasizing ethical beauty standards while delivering high-performance products. Malvika's red carpet appearance at Cannes reflects her blend of fashion savvy and influencer clout, positioning her as a role model for aspiring beauty entrepreneurs. Her YouTube channel balances fun, aspirational, and educational content, maintaining a loyal and engaged follower base.

In addition to content creation, Malvika made her Bollywood acting debut in 'Meri Pyaari Bindu', showcasing her versatile talents. Her inclusion in Forbes India's Top 100 Digital Stars and continued collaborations with global brands underline her stature as a leading influencer in India's dynamic beauty and fashion landscape. Her storytelling capabilities and trendsetting influence inspire followers to embrace their unique beauty authentically.
fun_fact: Made acting debut in Bollywood 'Meri Pyaari Bindu'. Forbes Top 100 Digital Star.

name: Saima Qadri (ShyStyles)
detailed_bio: Saima Qadri, known online as ShyStyles, is a Delhi-based influencer prominent in skincare, fashion hauls, and beauty tutorials. Developing her channel since 2016, she has grown an impressive subscriber base by authentically showcasing products and styling routines relatable to young Indian women. Saima blends fashion with beauty content, often exploring traditional and contemporary looks while imparting practical advice on skincare and self-care.

Her brand, Shy Styles Label, focuses on fashion accessories encompassing apparel and stylish additions to everyday wear. Celebrated for her engaging GRWM ('Get Ready With Me') videos, Saima creates content that merges routine beauty preparation with lifestyle elements, fostering a community that looks up to her approachable and fashionable demeanor.

Saima is also dedicated to fitness and wellness, integrating cardio, yoga, and balanced living into her content narrative. Her warm personality and reliable content quality have made her a trusted voice in the Indian influencer community, with strong ties to regional and international brands targeting a lifestyle-conscious audience.
fun_fact: Cardio and yoga devotee, fitness model, and pet lover.

name: Shalini Srivastava
detailed_bio: Shalini Srivastava is a Bangalore-based beauty content creator, founder of the 'Be Beautilicious' blog and YouTube channel. With over eight years of experience, she is known for her detailed product reviews, swatches, and honest commentary on beauty trends, offering insightful content that appeals to a discerning audience seeking substance over fluff.

Shalini has carved a niche for herself by promoting clean beauty through her makeup line, 'My Hues', which emphasizes cruelty-free, safe ingredients catering to a diverse set of consumers. Her solo creative approach and dedication to transparency in product assessments have won accolades from both brands and her community.

Beyond cosmetics, she often collaborates with wellness brands and has worked with established names like Kama Ayurveda and Sephora, highlighting her influence in the Indian beauty industry. Shalini's commitment to ethical beauty and community engagement sets her apart as a thoughtful, principled influencer.
fun_fact: Often works with brands like Kama Ayurveda, Sephora, and WOW Skin Sciences.

name: Sejal Kumar
detailed_bio: Sejal Kumar is a multifaceted content creator and fashion influencer based in Mumbai. With a degree in Economics from Shri Ram College of Commerce, she combines academic insight with creative storytelling to deliver content across fashion, wellness, travel, and lifestyle. Her relatable approach and high-quality production have earned her millions of subscribers and followers across platforms.

Her content goes beyond typical beauty tutorials, integrating sketch comedy and social commentary, making her one of India's most dynamic digital personalities. She was recognized as Cosmopolitan India's Instagrammer of the Year, solidifying her position in the elite influencer circuit.

Sejal advocates for body positivity and mental wellness, often weaving these themes into her content. Her authenticity and ability to connect deeply with millennials and Gen Z audiences continue to drive her growing influence internationally.
fun_fact: Featured in Cosmopolitan Blogger Awards, advocates body positivity.

name: Sonal Sagaraya
detailed_bio: Sonal Sagaraya is an Indo-Guyanese makeup artist, fashion blogger, and YouTuber who began her digital career in 2010. Based in Mumbai, she is celebrated for her inventive makeup tutorials, haul videos, and creative DIY hair and beauty projects. Sonal stands out for her ability to merge traditional beauty influences with contemporary trends, appealing to diverse audiences across India and the diaspora.

Her deep understanding of makeup artistry and fashion has earned her collaborations with multiple beauty brands. Sonal frequently shares lifestyle and healthy eating vlogs, connecting beauty with holistic wellness. Her nail art expertise and vibrant presentation style further showcase her versatility as an influencer.

Sonal’s channel offers a warm blend of entertainment and education, rooted in cultural identity and modern aesthetic sensibilities. Her consistent output and engagement with fans have cemented her reputation as a reliable and creative beauty guide.
fun_fact: Skilled nail artist, hosts frequent haul and healthy eating vlogs.

name: Roshni Bhatia
detailed_bio: Roshni Bhatia, founder of THECHIQUEFACTOR, is one of Delhi’s prominent fashion and beauty influencers. Holding a BA in English from Delhi University and an alumni of Pearl Academy, Roshni combines academic rigor with strong creative instincts. Her channel showcases curated fashion tips, beauty reviews, and lifestyle vlogs noted for their chic aesthetic and practical application.

Previously a producer for POPxo, her experience in content creation extends behind the scenes, enriching her ability to engage audiences authentically. Starting her channel in 2016, she rapidly grew her subscriber base with easy-to-follow tutorials and relatable style advice, targeting millennial women navigating city life.

Roshni emphasizes informed beauty choices and accessible fashion, frequently featuring Indian designers and sustainable brands. Her dynamic presence at fashion weeks and influencer events has positioned her among India’s leading beauty digital voices, inspiring thousands with her polished yet relatable content.
fun_fact: Rapidly grew channel after launching her own blog and YouTube brand.
